title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
summary: Anthropic merged Claude Cowork and chat into a unified platform where context, skills, and connectors flow across all interfaces. Introduces Claude Docs, Slides, and Design within conversations, with auto-detection of appropriate outputs (edit, present, download). Rollout begins with Pro and Max plans.

title: Claude for Financial Advisors
summary: Claude for Financial Advisors brings connectors and workflows tailored to advisor tasks, integrating BlackRock, Charles Schwab, and Addepar for meeting prep and portfolio analysis. Designed to reduce admin burden so advisors spend more time with clients, with built-in approval workflows and compliance controls.

title: Deploying AI from pilot to production
summary: Anthropic and Accenture released a guide for enterprise AI deployment covering seven key considerations across pilot and production phases. Includes a four-tier oversight model and cost-of-ownership framework to help teams scale beyond limited pilots and achieve sustained enterprise-wide impact.

title: What 1,000 small business owners taught us about AI
summary: Anthropic shared learnings from the Claude SMB Tour (1,000+ business owners across 10 cities), highlighting that hands-on training and peer learning drive adoption. Launched Claude SMB Trainer Program and a second tour phase, emphasizing that small businesses need validation, security transparency, and accessible interfaces.

title: Bringing Salesforce into Claude
summary: Anthropic launched a beta Salesforce plugin for Claude with 37 skills for sales workflows, integrating Salesforce and Slack connectors for accessing accounts and opportunities. Features include daily briefings, call prep, deal scoring, and pipeline dashboards, with early adoption by GitLab, Siemens, and Legora.

title: Claude for Small Business launches new workflows, integrations, and training programs
summary: Claude for Small Business expanded to 43 workflows and 27 new integrations including Shopify, Salesforce, Gusto, and tools for e-commerce, CRM, project management, and accounting. New free training workshops in 10 U.S. cities (Sept–Nov) help small business owners apply Claude to lead generation, proposal writing, marketing, and financial tasks.
